description: One venue in Boston or Denver (id, id_variant, or slug) and a page of its upcoming shows. With no city it looks in both. Use for “shows at Paradise” when you already have the venue id/slug; otherwise search_shows with venue=. Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total. id is required. For the directory of rooms, use list_venues.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville, Greater Boston) or denver (Denver, Boulder, the Colorado Front Range). Set denver for anything in Colorado.

id.description: Venue id, id_variant, or slug (e.g. paradise, paradise_rock_club).

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.

name: get_venue
title: One venue
